title: Humiliation of Broken Betrothal
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone thought Chen Ji would be reduced to a complete laughingstock, the Turtle Shell Fragment he carried in his bosom—never noticed by anyone—suddenly emitted a faint azure glow under the watchful eyes of all. It was the precursor of the Tianji Record's awakening.

text.content: Deep in the night, inside the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Servants' Quarters, Chen Ji lay on that creaking wooden bed, his consciousness sinking into chaos. The Heavenly Dao Will that swept past like spider silk in the previous chapter left him terrified—that gaze was cold and merciless, like an ancient deity from the primordial chaos, scrutinizing its chess piece.

Yet his sleep did not last long. The next morning, a piercing bell shattered the skies above Tianqing Sect—not the bell summoning disciples, but a festive ceremonial melody. From the direction of the front mountain Grand Council Hall, colorful flags fluttered and voices buzzed with excitement.

dialogue.content: "Chen-ge! Quickly, go to the front mountain! The Liu Family has arrived! They say they want to publicly announce something major—something related to your marriage with Young Master Chen!"

text.content: Chen Ji's movements paused for a moment. His fiancée, Liu Ruyan, his childhood sweetheart, his playmate from innocent years. Back then, Chen's father and Liu's father were both outer disciples of Tianqing Sect and had arranged this childhood betrothal. Liu Ruyan possessed exceptional talent and was now the number one beauty among the outer disciples; while he, Chen Ji, was universally acknowledged as a废物.

[Chen Ji's Inner Monologue] "The Liu Family's arrival at this moment is definitely not good news. The Tianqing Sect Competition just ended, and that girl from the Liu Family has caught the attention of the Inner Sect... Could it..." He let no one see his true feelings, merely rose quietly, donned that faded old robe, and walked toward the front mountain. Yet in his heart, he had already deduced and analyzed every possible scenario seven or eight times over.

Before the Grand Council Hall, a sea of people swarmed. Representatives from the three major sects came to observe, and Tianqing Sect's elders sat in their elevated seats. And right in the center of the crowd, a woman dressed in magnificent brocade stood proudly—Liu Ruyan. Today she had dressed meticulously, her radiance illuminating all, yet an unusual coldness pervaded her brow and eyes, unfitting her age.

dialogue.content: Liu Ruyan's gaze swept across the crowd and finally landed on that thin figure slowly approaching. A mocking curve twisted at the corner of her lips: "Chen Ji, you've come. Good, it saves me from sending someone to fetch you."

text.content: Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, his expression calm: "Ruyan, what important matter brings you personally to Tianqing Sect?" His voice was neither servile nor arrogant, as if he had no idea he was standing on the edge of a blade. Whispered murmurs rippled around him—how dare the废物address the number one beauty of the Inner Sect by her private name?

dialogue.content: From within the crowd, a cool gaze fixed upon all this—Su Qingyao. Standing behind the elders' seats for routine observation, she frowned slightly. This废物Chen Ji, facing such a scene, actually maintained this level of composure?

Liu Ruyan coldly laughed, producing from her sleeve a scroll of golden, resplendent marriage contract, and displayed it publicly: "Chen Ji, open your dog eyes wide and look clearly! This marriage agreement from years ago was nothing but a playful jest between your father and mine. Today, I, Liu Ruyan, in the presence of the three major sects, announce—the marriage is cancelled!"

text.content: The moment these words fell, uproar erupted throughout the venue. Seizing the opportunity, the Liu Family steward loudly proclaimed: "The Chen father and son—one a废物expelled from the sect, one unable to even break through Foundation Building! A toad lusting for swan meat, doesn't even pee to see what it looks like!"

Laughter erupted on all sides. Some jeered, some mocked, some even spat at Chen Ji. Chen Ji stood in place, allowing those obscene words and insults to cut at him like blades. His fists slowly clenched within his sleeves, fingernails digging deep into his palms, blood dripping—yet his face still displayed that unruffled expression.

[Chen Ji's Inner Monologue] "Humiliation to this degree... it seems the Liu Family is determined to trample on my face to climb higher. Interesting, truly interesting." In the depths of his pupils, a cold light flashed once, then was immediately concealed by an even deeper calm.

dialogue.content: Seeing Chen Ji remain silent, Liu Ruyan assumed he had been struck speechless by the blow, growing even more smug: "What? Scared stupid? Chen Ji, I advise you to认清现实. A废物like you isn't even qualified to carry my shoes! From now on, our grace and debt are severed, no more connection!"

choice.prompt: Facing such a public humiliation and disgrace, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Extreme forbearance, bowing head in defeat
choices.description: Temporarily lower the head, avoid pointless struggle, etch this humiliation deep in the heart, and wait to settle the score in the future.
choices.visible_cost: Publicly humiliated and losing all face
choices.visible_reward: Conceal strength, do not reveal trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Cold mockery and ridicule escalate, the Liu Family may become even more overbearing

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes and let out a long, heavy breath. When he opened them again, his eyes held a deathly calm: "Very well." Just one word, yet heavy as a thousand pounds. He bent down, picked up the torn marriage contract fragments from the ground, and turned to leave.

dialogue.content: "Hahaha! This废物has admitted defeat! Doesn't even dare to fart!" The Liu Family steward's mocking voice exploded behind him.

choices.text: Cold mockery and retaliation, an eye for an eye
choices.description: Use words to fight back, letting the Liu Family know that even waste has sharpness—it's not that I dare not retort, only that I'm waiting for the right moment.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Liu Family and bring greater trouble
choices.visible_reward: Maintain dignity, making those present look with new eyes
choices.risk_hint: Expose scheming, may attract the attention of those with ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji didn't move, only said calmly: "Divorce? Miss Liu certainly gave me sufficient face. I just feel curious—when the Chen and Liu families were engaged, Old Master Liu kowtowed three times before my father. Now this kindness is just written off like this?"

dialogue.content: Liu Ruyan's face changed dramatically, the Liu Family steward shouted sternly: "Insolent! Chen Ji, you waste, daring to be disrespectful to the Liu Family?"

choices.description: Chen Ji unable to bear such a blow, weeping publicly, losing face completely, becoming a true laughingstock
choices.visible_cost: Reputation completely destroyed, mocked by everyone
choices.visible_reward: Make everyone completely lower their guard
choices.risk_hint: May be disqualified as a servant disciple by the sect

text.content: Chen Ji's body began to tremble, and finally a crack appeared on that always-calm face. His eyes reddened, his lips quivered, yet no words could escape. "Ruyan... you... how could you..." The voice was hoarse, as if unable to bear this bolt from the blue.

The whole arena burst into laughter. Some laughed until they doubled over, others pointed at Chen Ji to mock and curse. "Look, the waste is crying!" "The toad is sniffling!" Liu Ruyan turned away in disgust, as if even one more glance would soil her.

However, just as Chen Ji was enduring this overwhelming humiliation, the Turtle Shell in his arms suddenly grew warm. The heat wasn't intense, but like a gentle current spreading from his chest to every limb. Chen Ji was shocked—was the Tianji Record Fragment responding to his emotions?

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's beautiful eyes slightly narrowed. She saw a faint green light flickering at Chen Ji's chest—that was... the aura of a spiritual artifact? No, that light was far too faint, almost negligible. But why would it appear at this exact moment? She silently recorded this scene in her heart.

text.content: Chen Ji thought: "Tianji Record... are you responding to my anger? Or are you saying... the time is not yet right?" He took a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions in his heart. The Turtle Shell's warmth gradually faded, but he could sense—it wasn't sleeping, but蓄势 (gathering strength).

dialogue.content: Liu Ruyan seemed bored by Chen Ji's silence, about to turn and leave, when she saw Chen Ji slowly raise his head. His gaze was terrifyingly calm, so calm that an inexplicable sense of unease rose in Liu Ruyan's heart—this kind of feeling, she had never seen in a waste.

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Liu Ruyan, at the Liu Family steward, at the laughing crowd, and said word by word: "The divorce, I accept. The marriage contract, I return to you." He gently placed that trampled, filthy marriage contract on the ground, "From now on, the Liu and Chen families are forever estranged."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji accepts the divorce, but the Liu Family steward refuses to let it go, continuing to insult Chen Ji's father—Chen Ji has been expelled from the sect. How should Chen Ji react?

choices.description: His father is Chen Ji's greatest reverse scale, but he knows this is not the time to reveal himself. Record the hatred in his heart, and repay it tenfold in the future.
choices.visible_reward: Don't let anyone see through the facade

text.content: The Liu Family steward, seeing Chen Ji show no reaction, became even more complacent and actually began to curse Chen Ji's father: "That waste of a father of yours was a betrayer back in the day! He stole the sect's secret manuals before being expelled, deserved to have his line cut off!"

Chen Ji's fists clenched in his sleeves until his knuckles cracked, and his palms were pierced by his fingernails, blood flowing freely. Yet his face remained that deathly calm. "Finished?" His voice was hoarse. "If you're done, I'm leaving."

choices.description: No counterattack, but releasing a trace of imposing aura, letting the Liu Family know that even waste has an untouchable bottom line.
choices.risk_hint: May arouse greater suspicion from Su Qingyao

text.content: Just as the Liu Family steward hadn't finished speaking, an invisible pressure suddenly erupted from Chen Ji. That pressure wasn't powerful, yet it was like a basin of cold water, silencing the surrounding laughter abruptly. For just a moment, Chen Ji收敛了气息 as if nothing had happened.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply. That moment just now... wasn't an illusion! This waste is definitely not as simple as it appears!

choices.text: Bearing grudges, settling accounts in autumn
choices.description: Carving every word from the Liu Family steward into his memory, silently swearing in his heart: Today's humiliation, I will repay tenfold.

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, his bangs covering his eyes. No one present could see his expression at this moment—that was a chilling calm, like the deathly stillness before a storm.

[Chen Ji's Inner Monologue] "Liu Family... today's humiliation, I Chen Ji have recorded it. Not that there's no retribution, just that the time hasn't come. When my Tianji Record reaches mastery, that will be the day your entire Liu Family meets your end!" His fingers trembled slightly—not from fear, but from rage compressed to its limit.

Just then, an aged voice came from the high platform: "Enough." Everyone turned to see Liu Feng, the Great Elder of the Tianqing Sect—Liu Ruyan's paternal great-uncle—slowly stroking his beard as he spoke. "Today's matter is merely a private dispute between the young. Since all of you have traveled far, why not move to the side hall for tea and conversation?"

Liu Feng's appearance temporarily ended this farce. He seemed to be helping Chen Ji out of a predicament, but in truth he was protecting the Liu Family's face—a waste being repudiated wasn't worth continuing to embarrass the Liu Family. The crowd gradually dispersed, leaving only Chen Ji standing alone, forlorn.

Chen Ji slowly turned and walked toward the Rear Mountain. His figure was desolate and lonely, his long shadow stretching under the sunset's lingering glow. No one noticed that the turtle shell in his embrace was pulsing, beat by beat, gradually synchronizing with his heartbeat—as if some long-dormant power was slowly awakening.

[Chen Ji's Inner Monologue] "Today's humiliation... I've repaid seven-tenths of it. The remaining three-tenths, I will personally collect." He raised his head to gaze at the horizon, the sunset like blood, dyeing half the sky crimson. "Liu Ruyan, you think you've won? No, this is only the beginning."

choice.prompt: After returning to the Servants' Quarters, as night fell, Chen Ji faced today's humiliation alone. How would he digest this hatred?

choices.text: Cultivate the Tianji Record, seek breakthrough
choices.description: Immediately attempt to communicate with the turtle shell, seeking a breakthrough in power. Today's humiliation made him understand—endurance is possible, but one must have the strength to counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: The Tianji Record may grant some revelation or power

text.content: In the depth of night, Chen Ji sat cross-legged on his bed, took out the Turtle Shell, and pressed it against his Brow Center. He tried to touch that faint connection with his consciousness. Gradually, an aged voice rang out in his mind: "Little fellow... you have finally begun to face your anger."

dialogue.content: "Remember, the Tianji Record is not a tool for you to endure in silence, but a chessboard for you to lay out the world. Anger is good, but anger also needs wisdom to control." The voice gradually faded, leaving only a profound remark: "The next volume... the condition to unlock it... you have already touched upon it."

choices.description: Sorting through today's events in his mind, analyzing the forces behind the Liu Family and the pieces that could potentially be used.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming a large amount of energy

text.content: Chen Ji took out a yellowed paper and began writing and drawing on it. The Liu Family, the Xuanwu Sect, the Inner Sect Elders... behind each name was an intricate web of relationships. He suddenly stopped his pen—Liu Feng, Liu Ruyan's grand-uncle, whose seemingly rescuing words were in fact warning him: Don't make a fuss, know when to stop.

[Chen Ji's Inner Monologue] "Interesting... the Liu Family's urgency to break off the engagement is definitely not simply because they嫌弃 I'm a废物. Liu Ruyan being valued by the Inner Sect? The Three Sects Tournament just ended? The water here is much deeper than I imagined."

choices.text: Writing a letter to his sister, seeking comfort
choices.description: In this most vulnerable moment, Chen Ji thought of his missing sister Chen Nian. He lifted his pen, wanting to tell her everything that happened today.
choices.visible_cost: Longing feelings might affect the mind
choices.visible_reward: Strengthening the determination to find his sister
choices.risk_hint: The letter might not reach its destination

text.content: Chen Ji lifted his pen but could not bring it down for a long time. His sister Chen Nian had been missing for five years. When she was taken away by people from the Holy Sect back then, those parting words "Brother, I'll be back" still echoed in his ears.

In the end, he only wrote one line on the paper: "Nian Nian, your brother was humiliated today. But don't worry. When your brother becomes stronger, I will definitely come to take you home." He folded the letter and tucked it into his chest. The Turtle Shell in his chest grew slightly warm, as if responding to his determination.

The next morning, Chen Ji appeared outside the Servants' Quarters as usual, sweeping fallen leaves and carrying odds and ends. He was still that timid废物, showing no abnormality on his face. But only he knew that the Turtle Shell Fragment had already branded an indelible mark on his chest.

Just as he bent down to sweep, a pair of cloud-patterned brocade boots stopped before him. Chen Ji looked up and saw Su Qingyao gazing down at him. Her gaze was complex, seemingly examining, yet also searching for something. "Chen Ji, about yesterday's matter... are you alright?" Her voice was cold, yet carried a trace of subtle concern.

Chen Ji lowered his eyes, revealing a bitter smile: "Thank you for your concern, Su Shixiong. It's just a broken engagement anyway—the sky won't fall." His tone was calm, as if speaking about something unrelated to him. But Su Qingyao noticed that as he said this, a cold light flashed in the depths of his eyes.

Su Qingyao said nothing more, only giving Chen Ji a deep look before turning to leave. But in the moment she turned, Chen Ji caught her slight smirk—that was the expression of a hunter discovering an interesting prey. Chen Ji's heart tightened: this woman was far more dangerous than he had imagined.

[Chen Ji's Inner Monologue] "Su Qingyao... just how much have you seen?" He gripped the broom in his hand, his knuckles whitening. "But it doesn't matter. As long as you have no evidence, you can never prove your speculation." He looked up at the horizon, the sunlight piercing his eyes, "The Liu Family... Su Qingyao... everyone is watching me. But they don't know—the distance between a chess piece and a chess player is sometimes just a single thought."

Just then, a commotion arose outside the Servants' Quarters. A disciple rushed over, panting as he announced: "Fellow brothers and sisters, big news! In three days, the Three Sects Tournament will be held at the Xuanwu Sect! The sect will select participating disciples, and all Outer Disciples and above can sign up!" Chen Ji's eyes slightly stirred—would Liu Ruyan be there too?

Night fell, and Chen Ji sat alone by his bed, taking out the Turtle Shell. Under the moonlight, that ancient Turtle Shell emitted a faint green glow, as if breathing. The humiliation he suffered today, the Turtle Shell had witnessed it all. It was waiting—waiting for Chen Ji to make his choice.

Just as Chen Ji was lost in thought, the Turtle Shell suddenly grew intensely hot. An aged voice rang out in his mind: "Little fellow, your performance today... disappointed me greatly." Chen Ji froze—this was the second time Mo Xiansheng had taken the initiative to speak with him. "Anger is power, but keeping it hidden in your heart—what use is that? What the Tianji Record needs is—a chess player, not a coward!"

Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, the calm in his eyes finally breaking. He said in a low voice: "Mo Xiansheng, what do you mean by a chess player?" Mo Xiansheng's laughter echoed in his mind: "In three days, the Three Sects Tournament. There, will be the stage where you first appear as a chess player. As for how to do it... you should already have an answer in your heart, right?" The voice faded, leaving only a profound silence.

Chen Ji held the Turtle Shell, speechless for a long while. Outside the window, moonlight flowed like water, casting upon his resolute face. His eyes had never been this clear. The humiliation of the broken engagement, he had not forgotten. But from this night onward, he would no longer be that enduring废物, but rather become a chess player who controls the chess game. The Three Sects' Sect Competition... Liu Ruyan... We'll meet at the Arena Platform.

Just as he was about to sink into dreamland, the Turtle Shell once again radiated gentle warmth, as if reminding him: the chess game has begun, once a piece falls, there is no regret. And that consciousness transcending mortal perception—the Eye of Heavenly Dao—seemed to be watching all of this from the distant Void, the corners of its mouth curving into an amused arc. Chess piece and chess player... who truly is the master of this game?
